task: FV2-018 — Flutter frameless desktop window chrome and branded title bar
summary: Extended live macOS acceptance for the native title-bar controls without restarting the running application.

checks.name: macOS native zoom and restore control
checks.observation: On the already-running BOOHTACORD Debug window, invoked the accessible 'zoom the window' secondary action exposed by the native green traffic-light control. The window expanded from its 1440x900 presentation to the display-sized 3440x1290 presentation; invoking the same action restored the original 1440x900 size. The text-only BOOHTACORD title and native traffic lights remained visible. The app was not restarted, and its authenticated session was preserved.

checks.name: Visual result retention
checks.observation: The live window contains user conversation content; no screenshot was saved into the repository. Before and after states were visually inspected through the live macOS UI.

limitations: macOS title-bar dragging and close/minimize actions remain untested.
Native Windows drag and window-control runtime acceptance remains NOT_RUN; FV2-018 stays open.
